notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
1. Level 1 When passing through a dark vent , many people are unaware of the existence of flash lights, so we installed a flash light key guide in front of the passage.

2. There was a problem with the rope in the last section of Level 3, so it was deleted. Now you can clear it with jumps instead of ropes.

notes.title: Last section rope patch
notes.notes: There was a little problem with yesterday's patch, so I fixed it again. The patch contents are the same.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where rope swings were being calculated differently depending on computer hardware. 
Because I work alone, the testing environment is very poor. Please let me know if the problem persists. 

thank you

- Lowered the difficulty of the last chase scene in chapter 3 (this one too).

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue where the force exerted by different hardware was different when swinging the rope.

2. In Chapter 1, we added a checkpoint at the point where we came out of the first vent.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes: There are many people who miss the view conversion key and first-person interaction key, so the key descriptions are displayed in the key guide at the beginning of the game.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
1. There was a problem that the mirror set to be immovable in the projector room in Chapter 2 could still move, so it was fixed again so that it could not move.
2. Fixed being unable to move sideways while hanging on the ledge. Also, the case where you can't climb when there is an object in front of you while hanging has been removed. This means you can always climb.

notes.title: small....patch
notes.notes:
My apologies for patching so often. I'm watching YouTube or streaming sites by myself to see if there's anything to fix, but one by one is added every day.
1. Added one checkpoint on top of the pile of boxes in Chapter 1.
2. In Chapter 1, the distance between the side view camera and the character was a bit narrowed because there was a problem with the camera lighting the other room.
3. Added a sliding description widget in front of the elevator in Chapter2.
4. Added a puzzle clue widget in front of the body tied up in the water in Chapter 3.
5. Removed the jump scare trigger that kills characters in the rope map in Chapter 3.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
1. chapter 2 prevented the doctor from detecting the sound on the shelf above the TV switch in the doctor's room. There was an uncomfortable part in the game, so it was fixed.

2. In chapter 3 doctor's room, made the iron cabinet fall over a bit later. The previous version felt too tight.

notes.title: small patch
notes.notes:
Chapter 1
- Fixed an issue where you could only jump from the starting room.
Chapter 2
- In the projector room, there was an issue where a puzzle could be solved with a single box unintentionally, blocking the doctor's path. To solve this, the structure was slightly modified.
- Fixed an issue where the doctor could get stuck in the chair in the doctor's room.
Chapter 3
- Changed the button puzzle because many people find it difficult. Fixed intelligence problems to find clues and solve them.
- Slightly lowered the difficulty of the last two chase scenes. The speed will be a little slower, so it will be a little easier to play.

Thanks for playing and thanks for the feedback.

- after chapter 2 projector room

notes.title: small patch
notes.notes:
1. In the following situations, there is a difference in speed depending on the hardware, and this has been improved.
- when turning the bolt
- When filling the gauge
- When pushing and pulling objects
2. In chapter 1, the problem of not coming out after falling on the drum next to the ladder has been improved.

There were no major problems with the game progress, but the difficulty could vary for each user, so it was corrected. Thank you.
